proposals.name: Precursor-fed CSM interaction
proposals.idea: A red supergiant shed dense circumstellar material in a slow precursor outburst beginning about five weeks ago, producing the early slow brightening. The supernova shock now running into that material converts kinetic energy at a roughly constant recombination temperature, so both bands rise together to a broad interaction plateau instead of following a nickel-powered Type Ia peak.

t_exp.meaning: start time of precursor outburst in days from now

tau_pre.meaning: rise timescale of precursor circumstellar emission in days

t_main.meaning: age in days after t_exp when main shock component reaches half maximum

tau_main.meaning: width in days of main shock brightening

t_plateau.meaning: age in days after t_exp when plateau decay begins

tau_decay.meaning: slow decline timescale of interaction plateau in days

base_b.meaning: constant host plus quiescent flux per band in microjansky

pre_b.meaning: plateau amplitude of precursor component per band in microjansky

main_b.meaning: plateau amplitude of main shock component per band in microjansky

proposals.predicts: It predicts a broad interaction plateau with nearly constant red g-r colour and only a slow decline for tens of days after maximum, rather than the rapid post-peak fade and colour evolution of the failed Ia hypothesis.

proposals.name: CSM interaction plateau
proposals.idea: A core-collapse explosion has struck a dense extended circumstellar shell, and shock power diffusing through that shell gives a month-long red rise rather than an 18-day nickel-powered Type Ia peak. The flux remains on a plateau while the shock crosses the shell, then falls when the shock exits and the shell becomes optically thin.

amp_b.meaning: plateau flux in each band in microjansky, encoding the red colour

t_mid.meaning: midpoint in days of the diffusion rise through the shell

w_rise.meaning: width in days of the interaction-powered rise

t_drop.meaning: time in days when the shock exits the shell and decline begins

proposals.predicts: It predicts the transient will stay near its present bright plateau for weeks and then decline, rather than already fading steadily as the failed Ia model forecast.

proposals.name: Hydrogen plateau slow riser
proposals.idea: A core-collapse explosion inside a massive hydrogen envelope and dense circumstellar material diffuses slowly, producing a power-law rise lasting about five weeks rather than the roughly twenty-day nickel-powered rise of a Type Ia. After shock breakout through the envelope the ejecta enter a hydrogen-recombination plateau at nearly constant, red luminosity.

amp_b.meaning: plateau flux in this band, lower in g than r for the red colour

p.meaning: power-law index of the expanding, diffusion-delayed rise

t_exp.meaning: explosion time in days relative to now

t_peak.meaning: days from explosion to reach the plateau

tau_tail.meaning: slow exponential decay time on the plateau

proposals.predicts: It predicts r remains near 250-330 microJy with g-r about 1.1 mag for tens of days, fading only slowly, rather than the Ia forecast decline below 100 microJy within about a week.
